apiServer.helpSteps:
1. On PC run: php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
2. Tap "Use local PC" or enter: http://YOUR-PC-IP:8000
3. Test connection → Save

Production: https://yourdomain.com
Demo staging: https://demo.bhuguard.com
